record.reason: The work models execution state across frameworks, tools, workspaces, and services and analyzes security violations caused by partial checkpoint/rollback boundaries. LangGraph/CrewAI examples include LLM calls but the contribution is recovery security; tests expose violations rather than measure inference/serving performance. The authors explicitly limit conclusions to rollback-induced security hazards, so no in-scope inference optimization is established.
record.title: Safe to Resume? Breaking Execution Continuity of Agent Execution via Rollback
